sources.title: Solomon Systech SSD1680 manufacturer datasheet (display-vendor mirror)

scope: Independent SSD1680 digital monochrome controller: 22 byte columns x 296 rows, two RAM planes; DEPG0213BN visible glass 122x250 at origin0. The usual 128x250 host drawing canvas is not the full controller capacity.

Commands 0x11,0x44,0x45,0x4e,0x4f address byte-X/little-endian-Y windows in X-major or Y-major order, with increment/decrement. Out-of-controller, direction-inconsistent and incomplete windows do not mutate RAM.
0x24 current BW and 0x26 secondary RAM remain separate. Only current BW RAM drives this monochrome glass. Digital inversion/bypass option from 0x21 is supported.

0x22 plus 0x20 controls clock/analog/update stages. A completed power operation does not publish a frame. Full and partial refresh snapshot the intended image; writes during BUSY are ignored as a conservative datasheet-required noninterruption policy.

Visible image survives reset and power loss. Deep sleep 0x10 modes1/2 holds BUSY high and only hardware reset exits. Caller reset(clear_ram=true) deterministically clears undefined unpowered SRAM without clearing the visible optical image.
BUSY rises at an operation and falls at its deadline; no host wall-clock timer or polling cadence is substituted.

timing.basis: Manufacturer bundled GxEPD2_213_BN nominal driver constants, not physical measurement
timing.override: Board adapter may set_timing_ms(full,partial,power_on,power_off) from its exact bundled driver; this does not claim physical calibration.

variantBoundary: Selected T5 V2.3.1 GxEPD2 BN uses X addresses0..15. Another bundled legacy GxDEPG0213BN adds one byte to X window and pointer. The emulator preserves command addresses and does not detect/repair that legacy driver shift.

Controller RAM is source-backed 176x296; visible region reflects the selected monochrome panel only. Source-output pin remapping (0x21 second byte), gate scan analog wiring, red color glass, arbitrary custom LUT optical effects, temperature/voltage, ghosting and readback are not implemented.
Partial delays are selected for documented controls0xCC/0xCF; other custom waveform modes are outside the stated contract.
